feature_name: Cloud Bigtable Key Visualizer in Console
summary: Key Visualizer for Cloud Bigtable was integrated into Google Cloud Console with enhanced scan range control and improved performance data retention.
extended_definition: Key Visualizer for Cloud Bigtable was integrated into Google Cloud Console with enhanced scan range control and improved performance data retention.

supporting_pages.title: Bigtable for Cassandra users \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: IAM and security In Bigtable, authorization is fully integrated into Google Cloud's IAM framework and requires minimal setup and maintenance.
The Bigtable Key Visualizer , a monitoring feature in the Google Cloud console, lets you perform advanced performance tuning.
Data modeling: flexibility with collections The Cassandra to Bigtable proxy adapter turns Cassandra collection types, such as maps, sets, and lists, into column families in Bigtable.
